Text: Levothyroxine should not be used to treat obesity or weight problems. Dangerous side effects or death can occur from the misuse of this medicine, especially if you are taking any other weight-loss medications or appetite suppressants.
Taking more than your recommended dose will not make this medicine more effective, and may cause serious side effects.
Levothyroxine has a narrow therapeutic index, which means the difference between too little and too much is small. Taking too much or too little over time can affect your heart, bones, blood sugar, cholesterol, digestion, memory and concentration, fertility, and, in children, growth and development. Your doctor will start you on a suitable dose and adjust it gradually based on blood tests.
You may not be able to use levothyroxine if you have certain medical conditions. Tell your doctor if you have an untreated or uncontrolled adrenal gland disorder or any heart problems such as a recent heart attack.
Triplet: ["Levothyroxine", "has effect on", "cholesterol"]

The relation 'has effect on' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug can influence or impact the physiological system, condition, or function specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the therapeutic or physiological effect specified by the object entity.
B. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
C. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'requires adjustment of': The subject drug necessitates changes or modifications to the treatment or dosage specified by the object entity.
